name: Rizuhble's Heaven Sent Headshots
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out in lane. Back off before you use it. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Assassinate T2. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Rapid Recharge, vitality 4.8k at Counterspell. Ultimate (Assassinate) is available from Rapid Recharge.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 7.4 to Crow Familiar's impact damage (0.74x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Rapid Recharge completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Rapid Recharge completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Rapid Recharge completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Counterspell, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: From Assassinate unlocks: gives that ability a charge to add to.
items.why: imminent: Rapid Recharge completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Adds 1 more charge to Assassinate (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Counterspell, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus. Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-25,600 (levels 16-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Crow Familiar T3, Assassinate T3.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 41.4 to Assassinate's low health enemy damage bonus (2.30x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.why: gives little now; payoff Diviner's Kevlar in 17600 souls (~17.6 min): timing review

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Assassinate: takes 18% off its 40s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Assassinate: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +64.4 on its low health enemy damage bonus (2.30x scaling).

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 14,400 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 25,600-56,000 (levels 28-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Stake T3, Flight T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Crow Familiar, impact damage) grows from 155 to 241. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Spiritual Overflow.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Assassinate gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (40s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 116s; 20% off is 23.2s per full rotation.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 69 to Assassinate's low health enemy damage bonus (2.30x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Assassinate deals damage (damage, low health enemy damage bonus), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (0 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 0 to 54% weapon damage. Upgrade of Spirit Lifesteal (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Counterspell? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enduring Speed.
sections.desc: Dying after Counterspell? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enduring Speed.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun heroes shoot you out of the sky.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Flight (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and Knockdown keep dropping you out of Flight.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep landing on you.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 116s of base cooldown across your kit, 40s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
